notes: Checked against Reactome's License Agreement and Disclaimer. Pathway illustrations, the icon library, art and branding materials are CC BY 4.0; the data are CC0; Reactome's software is Apache 2.0, except dependencies under copyleft licences and the FoamTree component, which has its own licence (pictures FoamTree makes on the website are free to use). So a paid app may show a pathway illustration or icon with the credit in attribution. CC BY doesn't allow suggesting Reactome endorses Ceder, even though the branding materials are CC BY. The disclaimer says the site's content is for education and research and isn't medical advice; it doesn't narrow the licence. Reactome may change the agreement at any time, so recheck it before relying on it. The library's pin command doesn't fetch from Reactome, so a library item is written by hand. The bank's agents don't read it and nothing from it goes into the bank.
